Jammu and Kashmir CM Omar Abdullah Marries Journalist Nidhi Razdan in New Delhi

02 Nov 2026, 04:31 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: news.abplive.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysJammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah announced his marriage to journalist Nidhi Razdan. According to reports, the ceremony took place in New Delhi.

Wedding Announcement and Ceremony Details

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah announced his marriage to journalist Nidhi Razdan. According to reports, the ceremony took place in New Delhi.

  • Announcement Date: Saturday, October 31, 2026
  • Marriage Date: Friday, October 30, 2026
  • Legal Framework: Special Marriage Act
  • Locations: Srinagar and New Delhi

Abdullah shared a post on social media platform X, stating that a new journey began. Sources indicated that the marriage was registered under the Special Marriage Act in New Delhi with family members present as witnesses.

Family Attendance and Background

Wedding functions were reportedly held across both Srinagar and New Delhi, attended by close relatives from both sides.

  • Attendees from Abdullah's side: Parents Farooq Abdullah and Mollie, along with his three sisters and close relatives.
  • Attendees from Razdan's side: Parents M.K. Razdan, a veteran journalist, and Sarla Razdan.

According to available details, this marks the second marriage for both individuals. The 56-year-old Chief Minister's previous marriage was dissolved earlier in the year following a Supreme Court order after a settlement between the parties.
